behavior: Ordered traces for prepared and unresolved draws retain decoded raster state plus every observed raw guest register and its validity mask.
The stencil reference/write-mask register is marked valid only when its PM4 write was observed.
Ordered-stream validation errors append the operation trace before returning, so an unresolved draw's partial registers remain visible in the rejection diagnostic.
change.scope: Diagnostics only. This does not implement shared physical EDRAM backing or alias transfer.

tests: Partial raster-register snapshots preserve the validity mask and captured value.
An unresolved ordered draw prints captured raw register values and stencil-register validity.
Renderer validation still rejects the unresolved draw before submission and includes the partial register trace in the error.
